fields.description: The Acres Villas is the three- to five-bedroom standalone-villa collection within The Acres in Dubailand. Open-plan rooms, courtyards and outdoor living areas connect homes to landscaped surroundings, while layouts range from two-storey homes to variants with an additional upper level.

overview: The reviewed plans show layouts with a maid room and distinct indoor and outdoor living spaces. Their disclaimer states that swimming pools and landscape features are not included and remain the buyer’s responsibility; rendered gardens should not be read as supplied works.
research.locationNote: The Acres in Dubailand, with access described via Sheikh Zayed Bin Hamdan Al Nahyan Street and Emirates Road. Confirm the selected phase entrance and plot position; community access and road delivery may be phased.
research.priceNote: The current linked sheet gives starting guides of AED 6.5 m for three bedrooms,7.8 m for four and 9.5 m for five. These are release-specific marketing guides, not confirmed current stock or prices for every earlier phase.
research.paymentNote: Current sheet: 10% booking; 10% July 2025; 10% November 2025; 5% each February/May/August/November 2026 and February/May/August 2027; 35% August 2028 handover. Past launch milestones require a selected-unit balance statement; do not reuse this calendar for every release.
research.handoverNote: The currently linked release sheet estimates August 2028. Other phases may have different dates; confirm the selected plot’s contract.
